notes.title: Zquirrels Jump just switched from paid to free!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33794088/b889fa81e7e1090ea68394b63fda096d8f29b258.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33794088/b55ed2445cdfb1a865fc488f204e1e53a2f7c568.jpg[/img][/url]

From now on Zquirrels Jump will be free for everybody till the end of the world, and let's hope it won't happen too soon.
There won't be ads, there won't be microtransactions, just try to enjoy this super frustrating rage game for yourself!

Cheers!

notes.title: We know the date of the switch to free for Zquirrels Jump
notes.content:
Zquirrels Jump is going to switch to free on Monday (13.05.2019).

We also were asked if there will be the last sale. The answer is no. We stated that we don't want to 'milk dying cow' and it would be wrong to try the last sale to get some income. Our goal was always to deliver high-quality products, enjoyment, and fun. We don't want to be that developer who tries -90% on a game that clearly isn't selling well.
We got a few offers Steam Keys for pennies, but we would rather give you this game for free than earn 10 cents on a player.
And if you want to buy it to support us before the switch, then you can be sure that we will appreciate it and you won't regret spending a few dollars.

Cheers!

notes.title: Zquirrels Jump is switching from paid to free!
notes.content:
[h1]Zquirrels Jump is switching from paid to free![/h1]

After a while, we have decided to switch to free with Zquirrels Jump. We've put a lot of effort in this game and it's now clear for us that it won't earn money. We would rather see gamers enjoying this game than earn a few bucks per month.

Incomprehension, our second PC game (Archeo: Shinar) is doing significantly better and we would rather focus on the game which is providing us not only money but also more new players every month. And if Zquirrels Jump doesn't generate noticeable income and it doesn't gain new players, then we need to face the facts that it was not a good investment (because it obviously wasn't) and take some action. 

We put a lot of work in this game and we want people to enjoy it even if there are not enough ones willing to pay for this rage game. We understand you, we hear you and we probably won't deliver you another rage game in a long time.

However, we encourage you to try Zquirrels Jump, this time for free. We could cut a few levels from the game and give you a free demo, but we just don't want to 'milk the clearly dying cow' (The dying cow is a euphemism for Zquirrels Jump). Instead, we want to encourage everybody to have some fun with our creation.

We probably won't do that with any other game because, you know, without microtransactions, ads or pay to play we won't earn any money, and it's not a good way to run a business. But this time we can do this, and we are going to, don't try to stop us!

The game should be free for everybody in a week (7 days from today).

Cheers!
